tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Facts about Irish citizenship by descent as Erin Citizenship handles it: who qualifies, dual citizenship, timeline, cost, what we do, and the main pages.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Our public answers to common questions about Irish citizenship by descent (documents, travel, dual citizenship, timeline, cost, family situations). Pass the person's question to get the closest answers, or leave it empty for the full list.

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Quick read of whether a family line qualifies for Irish citizenship by descent, based on the closest ancestor born on the island of Ireland (Northern Ireland included). Gives the same preliminary read as the eligibility check on https://erincitizenship.com/check, plus the facts still missing, anythi

tools.name: get_document_checklist
tools.description: The documents a Irish citizenship by descent case needs, as Erin Citizenship publishes them: civil records for the family line, proof of the ancestor's status, apostilles and translations, and who obtains what. Pass the ancestor's generation to see how many people in the line need records.

tools.name: estimate_cost_timeline
tools.description: Erin Citizenship's published cost and timeline for a Irish citizenship by descent case: our fees, government fees and pass-through costs, and how long each stage takes. The exact quote follows the free eligibility review.

tools.name: find_records
tools.description: Where the records of a Irish ancestor are usually kept (archives, civil registries, naturalization records) and how they are obtained, as Erin Citizenship describes it.

tools.name: start_case
tools.description: Sends the person's details to Erin Citizenship for a free eligibility review, exactly like the form on https://erincitizenship.com/check. We read the family line and reply by email; a confirmation email arrives shortly. Only call this after the person has clearly asked to send their details to Erin

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_case · Private data: get_faq, check_eligibility, get_document_checklist, find_records · Public sink: start_case.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_case · Private data: get_faq, check_eligibility, get_document_checklist, find_records · Public sink: start_case

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
